modules.title: 对象存储和数据库怎样分工

items.title: 整块文件进对象存储
items.text: 本例把图片、视频和附件等文件作为对象存入对象存储；文章记录保存相关对象键或地址，访问方式由项目权限配置决定。

items.title: 结构化文字进数据库
items.text: 本例把文章标题、作者、状态等可查询字段和关联对象键放在数据库记录中；读取文章后再按项目配置请求封面文件。

items.title: 本例中的存储分工
items.text: 本例把要按标题、作者或状态查询的文章字段放进数据库，把封面文件作为对象存入对象存储；其他架构要按查询、事务和文件访问需求判断。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 本例用文章记录保存归属、状态和对象键，方便业务查询；读取封面时仍按项目的访问控制判断权限。其他架构可以用不同方式组织这些数据。

lessonPractice.title: 文章列表要按标题搜索，并单独加载封面。本例怎样安排这两种内容？

options.label: 封面放对象存储，标题和图片位置存数据库
options.feedback: 对。本例把封面文件放对象存储，把标题等可查询字段和对象键放数据库。其他项目也可以采用不同方案，应按文件访问、事务和体量需求判断。

options.label: 把封面和标题拼在一起，存进同一个字段
options.feedback: 这会把图片字节和标题文字混在同一字段，不符合本例按业务字段查询并单独请求封面的设计。也有系统把文件内容存数据库，需结合访问、事务和体量评估，不能只凭文件大小判断性能。

options.label: 封面和标题放本机浏览器，供所有人查看
options.feedback: 本地存储只在这一台设备上，换设备或清缓存就没了。

en.title: An article list searches by title and loads cover images separately. How are the two stored in this example?

options.label: Store the cover as an object, and its title and key in an article record
options.feedback: Correct. In this example, the cover file goes to object storage while queryable fields and its object key go in the database record. Other designs may fit other needs; consider access, transactions, and file size.

options.label: Combine the cover bytes and title in the same database field
options.feedback: This would combine image bytes and the title in one field, unlike this example, which queries article fields and requests the cover separately. Some systems store file contents in a database; assess access, transactions, and volume rather than assuming file size alone decides performance.

options.label: Keep both in this browser for everyone to view
options.feedback: Local storage exists only on this device; it is gone after switching devices or clearing cache.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 本例采用对象存储保存文章封面，在文章记录里保存标题、归属、状态和关联对象键或地址。先检查项目现有的权限设计，再上传一张封面，确认刷新后仍能按预期显示。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: For this article example, store the uploaded cover as an object and keep the title, ownership, status, and object key or address in the database record. Check the project's existing access-control design, then upload a cover and confirm it still displays after refresh.

learning.assumes: You have seen image or file upload features, or heard of cloud storage.
learning.outcome: You can explain how the cover file, article record, and object address relate in this example, and know that a storage design depends on project needs.

modules.title: How object storage and the database divide the work

items.title: Whole files go to object storage
items.text: In this example, images, videos, and attachments are stored as objects; the article record keeps a related object key or address, while access depends on the project's permission setup.

items.title: Structured text goes to the database
items.text: In this example, the database record holds queryable article fields such as title, author, and status along with the related object key; the page then requests the cover according to the project's access setup.

items.title: Storage split in this example
items.text: This example keeps article fields that need queries in the database and stores the cover file as an object. Other architectures should be chosen based on query, transaction, and file-access needs.

modules.title: What it does not do
modules.text: In this example, the article record stores ownership, status, and the related object key for business queries; file access still follows the project's access-control path. Other architectures may organize this data differently.

distinctions.label: Database
distinctions.text: In this example, the database stores queryable article fields and file ownership while object storage holds the file. Some systems store file contents in a database; choose based on query, transaction, volume, and access needs.

distinctions.label: Browser storage
distinctions.text: Browser storage belongs to the current browser environment; object storage lives on a server or cloud service. Access by address still depends on permissions, network reachability, and URL lifetime.
